newsitem.title: POLAND: HSBC UNIT CLEARED TO BUY POLISH BROKERAGE.
newsitem.headline: HSBC UNIT CLEARED TO BUY POLISH BROKERAGE.

text.p: HSBC Investment Bank Holdings BV, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, has received all the required permission to buy a majority stake in Polish brokerage Dom Inwestycyjny Guziejewski and Albrecht SA, HSBC said.
HSBC said in a statement on Friday it would buy 98.57 percent of the brokerage.
Last month Hubert Janiszewski, the director of HSBC's Polish unit, said his company had still needed the approval of the country's anti-monopoly office.
He said HSBC planned to increase the brokerage's capital so it could become a member of the Warsaw bourse and that his firm eventually sought to buy all the brokerage's shares.
Guziejewski and Albrecht netted 200,000 zlotys last year.
